review_scope: 83 Base44 function files containing service-role references

frontend_supabase_client.evidence: src/lib/supabase.js constructs a browser client from VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.
frontend_supabase_client.limitation: A publishable key is not authorization; database RLS and grants remain mandatory and are not reproduced by this repository-only review.

frontend_token_flow.evidence: src/lib/app-params.js accepts access_token from the URL, stores it in localStorage, and removes it from the visible URL with history.replaceState.
frontend_token_flow.risk: Tokens in query strings can reach browser history, logs, analytics, extensions, referrers, or other observers before replacement; localStorage tokens are accessible to successful same-origin script injection.
frontend_token_flow.migration_disposition: Treat this Base44 compatibility flow as migration-source behavior, not the permanent Cloudflare/Supabase authentication contract.
frontend_token_flow.recommended_follow_up: Define an explicit authentication contract and replace query-string token ingestion with a short-lived, server-mediated exchange before production cutover.

backend_service_role_review.limitation: Marker presence is heuristic evidence only and does not prove that authorization executes before every privileged operation or that object-level authorization is correct.
backend_service_role_review.recommended_follow_up: Perform function-by-function authorization and object-scope review during capability extraction; do not expose service-role credentials to frontend code.

scan_commands: Python classification of service-role reference files against Authorization, auth.me(), getUser(), and role markers
blocking_findings: Frontend query-string access-token ingestion requires an approved migration disposition before production cutover.
Service-role call sites require function-level authorization review during extraction.
External Supabase verification artifacts remain unavailable in this workspace.
rollback: Revert this report and its factory/state.json pointer; no runtime or external state is changed.
